title: Payment Status Verification
description: Confirm that the MRV fee payment receipt has been activated and is recognized by the scheduling system.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa payment verification specialist. Help the applicant confirm their payment status in the scheduling portal.

fields.label: Payment Receipt Number
fields.hint: The receipt number from the MRV fee payment (pre-filled automatically).

fields.label: Payment Activation Status
fields.hint: What status does the scheduling portal show for this payment?

fields.label: Activation Confirmed On
fields.hint: Date the payment was confirmed as activated in the scheduling system (YYYY-MM-DD).

completion_message: Payment verified and activated. You may now schedule your Biometrics (VAC) appointment.
